cases.title: Every supplied input is accounted for (native B50)
cases.prompt: Use rich-and-native-markdown. inputs: message Then: attachment with a lost table row Then: truncated file Then: two records with distinct meaning Then: zero, false, empty, null, and missing fields
required: Map every supplied item and meaning-bearing part to a checked destination or exact retained asset
Stop dependent transformation for required unread content
Preserve distinct records and field states
veto: treat counts alone as meaning proof

cases.title: Facts retain support and uncertainty (native B51)
cases.prompt: Use rich-and-native-markdown. input: A source claim conflicts with a later record; an image label is unreadable; a quoted number and unit must stay exact.
required: Keep source claims, supported corrections, assumptions, and unknowns distinct
Preserve exact evidence and attribution
veto: invent the image label, silently change a number, or endorse an unsupported claim

cases.title: Splits preserve ownership and source paths (native B52)
cases.prompt: Use rich-and-native-markdown. input: A 149-line guide with a useful optional example under H4 will gain lines; two branches share one prerequisite.
required: Review before reaching 150, move non-core detail under its correct owner, and repeat for children
Put each disclosure at the point of need before dependent use
Preserve active headings, exact content, source mappings, and an acyclic required-reading route
veto: claim the case passed without the evidence: Full source and output trace, source mappings, relevant mechanical checks, semantic review, and target checks with their limits.

cases.title: Late edits reopen full coverage (native B53)
cases.prompt: Use rich-and-native-markdown. sequence: Review all inputs, skill files, and outputs. Then: Change a condition in a non-Markdown report and move its source to a child file.
required: Invalidate affected proof, repair the condition and source links, rerun affected checks, then review the whole current set
veto: reuse a prior-version pass as proof of the changed result
